image_headline: Your Postcode Is Not Your Potential
image_subtext: A laptop in Dhaka reaches the same internet as a laptop in New York.

captions.x:
Hard truth for Bangladeshi entrepreneurs:

Your postcode is not your potential.

The same internet that built Silicon Valley is in your pocket right now.

The only difference is what you do with it today.

#Mindset #DigitalBangladesh #Entrepreneurship
